_purpose: Machine-readable register of the rails the Phase 0 exit accepts as excluded because no acquisition path exists yet (class no-source) or because a ruling paused them. scripts/six-county-completeness.mjs reads it: a no-source rail is accepted only while its entry here says status carried (or paused-by-ruling), so dropping a rail from the roadmap reopens it in the exit. A ruled-exclusion rail (P-337) is accepted only while its entry says paused-by-ruling, names the rail's Phase 1 row, and no tracked _inbox close names that row; a close the seat has read and found not to retire the reason is listed by path in acknowledgedCloses, never by count. Edit only with a plan row or ruling named in the entry.
